verdict.line: You win short, violent trades once you've baited Riposte and landed both hits of Facebreaker; she wins any fight that drags past her 3rd-4th vital proc or reaches her full item spike.

brief.thesis: This lane is decided by two cooldowns: Fiora's W (Riposte) and Sett's E (Facebreaker). If she has Riposte up, she dictates the trade and can no-sell your engage; if you've made her burn it on a bait, your Grit-fueled all-in goes almost unanswered. Fiora's passive (Duelist's Dance) rewards long fights through true damage and healing on vitals, so the longer a duel runs, the more it tilts toward her - Sett needs to end fights fast, not grind them.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and she has Q charge
theirWindow.what: She can poke with Q (Lunge) and threaten to parry anything you throw back, so don't lead with your real combo - she'll riposte your E or empowered auto and swing the trade hard in her favor.

yourWindow.when: Riposte is down or just baited out
yourWindow.what: Walk in and land both hits of E (Facebreaker) for the stun, then W (Haymaker) for the heal, finishing with R (The Show Stopper) if she's the nearest target - this is your all-in window and it's close to unanswerable.

start.why: Sustains through her Q poke and gives the early lifesteal to win short trades.

boots.why: Cuts the auto-attack and on-hit true damage that fuels her vitals procs.

core.why: Standard Sett spike - damage, tenacity-adjacent slow resist from movespeed, and heal amp for W.
Armor shred and health let you win the extended trades you can't avoid once she scales.
The shield keeps you alive through her burst window right as she reaches her vitals and stops you getting executed mid all-in.

situational.when: she's snowballing off vitals healing, since grievous wounds cuts that sustain hard even though it isn't a heal spell
she's building crit or heavy on-hit and out-dueling you late
you need to threaten a reset all-in without fearing the trade

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps through the extended trades you'll inevitably get pulled into and gives the heal amp your all-ins need.

summoners.why: Ignite shuts down the vitals healing that lets her win extended fights, and rewards you for pressuring her early all-in windows.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before committing
playing.detail: Throw a single poke or the first hit of E rather than opening with your full combo. If she parries that, Riposte is down for a long cooldown and your real all-in goes through clean.

playing.title: Land both hits of Facebreaker
playing.detail: E only stuns if both hits connect on her specifically - stick to her through the first hit so the second lands, otherwise you've spent the cooldown for nothing.

playing.title: Check the nearest target before R
playing.detail: Show Stopper (R) grabs whoever is nearest, so don't cast it with minions or her jungler between you and Fiora.

playing.title: Count her vitals procs
playing.detail: Duelist's Dance triggers big true damage and healing once she's hit several unique vitals - if she's already proc'd 2-3, disengage instead of grinding the fight out.

playing.title: Spend Grit proactively
playing.detail: Pit Grit fills fastest while you're missing health, and W's heal scales off missing HP - use Haymaker when it caps instead of holding it and risking losing the charge to poke.

playing.title: Punish her Q cooldown
playing.detail: Lunge is her only gap closer/escape pre-6 and isn't spammable - close distance immediately after she uses it to poke or reposition.

playing.title: Don't duel post-11 without a plan
playing.detail: Once she has her first item and multiple vitals proc'd, a straight extended 1v1 favors her - force short trades or wait for jungle help instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Ability names, item builds, and rune trees are given from general knowledge and may have shifted since - verify Sett/Fiora numbers and the current item/rune tree against the live patch before locking in.
